whatIs: Overflow brings together design resources made by one person, the same author as Keyline Icons and Preline UI: about 1,100 Notion-style icons, more than 450 illustrations, more than 350 isometric drawings (some animated) and 20 3D avatars for AI agents, in SVG, PNG and as an editable Figma file.
It's a good fit when you want a distinctive, consistent visual style for a landing page, a product or a presentation, and you'd rather try the free part before paying.
uses: Illustrating a product landing page with isometric drawings instead of stock photos.
Using Notion-style icons, in regular or duotone, in an app or dashboard.
Connecting its MCP server to a coding agent so it can look up an icon and insert it into your project as SVG or JSX.
caveats: Only part of the catalog is free: 194 icons, 45 illustrations (15 from each pack) and 71 isometric drawings as still images. The rest, including the animated isometrics, requires the Pro license.
You can't redistribute the assets on their own or use them to build another pack or library; Pro assets also can't be uploaded to public repositories.
Pro is for a single person and purchases are non-refundable; for agencies or multiple users you have to request a custom license.
pricingNote: There's a free set; the Pro license costs $99 as a one-time payment and includes the full catalog and anything added later.
idealFor: People who need icons and illustrations with their own style for commercial projects.
